given: a location holds no stock records
when: the operator views that location on the home stock-by-location screen
then: an explicit "No stock at this location" message is shown for that location instead of a blank page or an empty table

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 cover the populated-table outcome; AC3 covers the distinct empty-location outcome, which can break (blank page shown) while the populated table still renders rows correctly, and vice versa.
